name: muser
description: Local-first semantic image search — index folders of images and find them by natural-language description (SigLIP/CLIP embeddings + LanceDB), fully offline with no API keys. Plus color search, AI-origin signals, and a cloud generate add-on.

MUSER_SERVICE_URL.title: Muser Service URL
MUSER_SERVICE_URL.description: Override the embedded muser service URL (default http://127.0.0.1:7777). The MCP server is a thin HTTP client of `muser serve` and auto-spawns it if it isn't already listening.

OPENAI_API_KEY.title: OpenAI API Key
OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Optional. Only used by the captioning / generate add-ons. Core search/index/color run on-device with no key.

FAL_KEY.title: fal.ai API Key
FAL_KEY.description: Optional. Only used by the cloud generate pipeline (image/3D/LoRA). Core search is fully local and never needs it.
